rationale: The description explicitly includes review submission, acceptability determination, dashboard error handling, reporting, and statistics. Because it does not say whether acceptability is determined by a human, rules, or AI, the non_ai label remains weak and forced.
evidence_spans: including reading each review and determining if each review is acceptable or unacceptable and making any applicable updates
conflict_response: Both proposals correctly identify the unresolved mechanism for acceptability determination. The surrounding dashboard and reporting functions cannot upgrade the included ambiguous determination feature; no affirmative AI signal supports non_ai as the best forced call.
